jobs.description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The Role: Build the data, decisioning and automated systems that allow Paddle to take more good risk while reducing fraud losses, unnecessary customer friction and manual work. Paddle’s Merchant of Record model makes risk a critical part of the product and its economics. Seller quality, buyer fraud, payment acceptance, refunds, disputes, reserves and card-scheme exposure cannot be optimised independently. This role will connect those signals, identify where the largest value is being lost, turn risk priorities into working controls and workflows, prove their effect in production, and establish a durable owner once a capability becomes repeatable. Map the end-to-end seller risk system, its data, decisions, controls, owners and failure points. Establish the baseline before building: fraud losses, alert yield, time-to-detect, exposure at detection and analyst effort, with losses reconciled with Finance. Own the health of live controls: every rule and check has an owner, an expected volume, a measured yield and alerting when it goes quiet or drifts, and every change is tested and impact-assessed before release. Build and maintain a labelled library of confirmed fraud cases and a shared fraud typology: the basis for rules now and for machine-learning models with Data Science later. Build a value-ranked portfolio of risk opportunities. Translate risk problems into clear product, data and engineering work with measurable acceptance criteria. Design seller risk tiers that set payout timing, reserves and limits, giving good sellers more room and tightening controls on riskier ones. Backtest rules and risk scores on point-in-time data, and design control experiments, shadow tests and phased roll-outs that measure both loss reduction and legitimate-customer impact. Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts. Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it. Alpaca is proudly backed backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator. Our Team Members: We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond! We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca 's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply. Your Role As a Senior Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will build and own the frameworks, tooling, and CI/CD infrastructure that let Alpaca ’s engineers ship new features quickly and reliably. This is a software engineering role at its core: you will spend most of your time writing Go, designing automated test frameworks, and digging into application code and Kubernetes when needed. Just as importantly, you will help redefine how we use AI to raise the bar on quality - leveraging LLMs and AI-driven tooling to generate tests, catch regressions before they ship, and turn every incident into durable, automated coverage. We are looking for engineers who treat quality as an engineering discipline and see AI as a force multiplier for it - people who build the systems that make testing fast, reliable, and effortless for the teams that depend on them. Leverage AI and LLM-based tooling to accelerate test generation, harden regression coverage, and turn production incidents into automated tests - embedding these practices into the frameworks the whole engineering org relies on.
